lines.text: Say: Please fill out the form.
Fill out means write your details.
British speakers often say fill in!
Quick quiz! Which one sounds natural?
Fill out! Please fill out this form.

data.mean: = write your details on a form
data.aha: British speakers often say fill in!
data.ex: I filled out the form online.
